basic.name: Disruption Pulse
basic.description:
Fire a burst of energy forward, dealing 142~~0.05~~ damage to all enemies it passes through.

Hitting the center of a Warp Rift will cause it to explode, dealing additional damage.

basic.name: Warp Rift
basic.description:
Open an unstable Warp Rift at a location that takes 1.25 seconds to arm, which then Slows nearby enemies by 25% lasting 3 seconds.

Armed Warp Rifts explode when they expire or when hit by Disruption Pulse, dealing 261~~0.05~~ damage to nearby enemies.

basic.name: Photon Cannon
basic.description:
Warp in a Photon Cannon that deals 105~~0.04~~ damage. Lasts for 13 seconds.

While within a Pylon's Power Field, Photon Cannons gain 40% Attack Speed over 4 seconds and reveal nearby enemies.

heroic.name: Pylon Overcharge
heroic.description: For 8 seconds, increase the size of Pylon power fields and allow them to attack enemy Heroes within it for 96~~0.04~~ damage per second. Pylons are Invulnerable for the duration.

heroic.name: Null Gate
heroic.description:
Vector Targeting
Project a barrier of negative energy in the target direction that lasts 4 seconds. Enemies who touch the barrier take 76~~0.04~~ damage per second and are Slowed by 80% for as long as they remain in contact with it.

trait.name: Warp In Pylon
trait.description:
Warp in a Pylon that generates a Power Field and grants vision of the surrounding area. Probius only regenerates mana while inside a Power Field. Enemy Heroes and Minions drop Minerals when killed. Gather Minerals to reduce the cooldown of Warp In Pylon by 0.75 seconds.

Up to 2 Pylons can be active at a time.

mount.name: Worker Rush
mount.description:
Activate to gain an additional 60% Movement Speed for 5 seconds. Taking damage ends this effect early. Worker Rush is always active while at the Hall of Storms.

Passive: Probius moves 10% faster by hovering over the ground.

level1.name: Echo Pulse
level1.description: Disruption Pulse now returns to Probius 1.25 seconds after reaching its target, dealing 100% damage on the return trip.

level1.name: Warp Resonance
level1.description:
Quest: Hit Heroes with Warp Rift explosions.

Reward: After hitting 8 Heroes with Warp Rift explosions, increase the explosion damage by 120.

Reward: After hitting 16 Heroes with Warp Rift explosions, Warp Rift gains 1 additional charge.

level1.name: Gather Minerals
level1.description:
Quest: Gather Minerals to increase the Health of Photon Cannons by 8, up to 560. 

Reward: After collecting 70 Minerals, Photon Cannons deal 35% more damage.

level4.name: Photon Barrier
level4.description: While a Photon Cannon is alive and powered, Probius gains 40 Spell Armor.

level4.name: Turbo Charged
level4.description: Worker Rush grants an additional 10% passive Movement Speed while in a Power Field, and its cooldown is reduced by 14 seconds.

level4.name: Shield Capacitor
level4.description: Probius gains permanent Shields equal to 10% of his max Health. Shields regenerate quickly as long as he hasn't taken damage recently.

level7.name: Particle Accelerator
level7.description:
After hitting 3 Heroes with Disruption Pulse, the next Warp Rift detonated by a Disruption Pulse fires 4 additional pulses that deal 78~~0.05~~ damage from the impact location in different directions.

Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Disruption Pulse by 0.5 seconds.

level7.name: Rift Shock
level7.description: Hitting a Warp Rift with Disruption Pulse within 1 second of it arming deals 105~~0.05~~ damage over 3 seconds.

level7.name: Tower Defense
level7.description: Reduce Photon Cannon's cooldown by 3.5 seconds when Disruption Pulse or Warp Rift damages an enemy Hero.

level10.name: Pylon Overcharge
level10.description: For 8 seconds, increase the size of Pylon power fields and allow them to attack enemy Heroes within it for 96~~0.04~~ damage per second. Pylons are Invulnerable for the duration.

level10.name: Null Gate
level10.description:
Vector Targeting
Project a barrier of negative energy in the target direction that lasts 4 seconds. Enemies who touch the barrier take 76~~0.04~~ damage per second and are Slowed by 80% for as long as they remain in contact with it.

level13.name: Aggressive Matrix
level13.description: Pylon's Power Field grants allied Heroes 35% increased Attack Damage.

level13.name: Power Overflowing
level13.description: Pylon's Power Field grants allied Heroes 10% increased Spell Power and 2 Mana per second.

level13.name: Shield Battery
level13.description: Pylon's Power Field grants allied Heroes 28~~0.04~~ Shields per second, up to 112~~0.04~~. Shields persist for 2 seconds after exiting a Pylon Power Field.

level16.name: Quantum Entanglement
level16.description: Enemies continue to be Slowed for 3 seconds after their last contact with a Warp Rift.

level16.name: Gravity Well
level16.description: Enemies are Slowed more the closer they are to the center of the Warp Rift, up to a maximum slow of 60%.

level16.name: Interference
level16.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Warp Rift explosions have their Spell Power reduced by 35% for 5 seconds. Additionally, enemies hit by Warp Rift explosions are knocked away from the center.

level20.name: Construct Additional Pylons
level20.description: Probius can now have up to 3 active Pylons, and increase the damage of Pylon Overcharge by 25%.

level20.name: Gate Keeper
level20.description: Null Gate lasts indefinitely if either end is within a Power Field.

level20.name: Shoot 'Em Up
level20.description:
Enemy Heroes hit by Disruption Pulse take a bonus 2.5% of their maximum Health as damage.

Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Disruption Pulse by 0.5 seconds.

level20.name: Probius Loop
level20.description: Whenever a Rift explosion hits 1 or more enemy Heroes, create a new Warp Rift in the same location.
